title: Microsoft 365 admin center: dedicated License Requests page for Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, dedicated page navigation, administrator roles and self-service purchase controls are supported. The existing Requests-tab route stops short of its approval control, and the licensing discussion should clarify Microsoft's documented Copilot rename. The cited pages opened successfully, including the updated November announcement.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a dedicated Microsoft 365 admin center page for discovering, reviewing and managing user-submitted Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests.
claims.quote: We are introducing a new dedicated License Requests page in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center to help admins more easily discover, review, and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests submitted by users.
